success.description: As above, and the target recovers 1 wound.
As above, and the target recovers 2 normal wounds.

sigmarsComet.description: You may choose another critical wound the target is suffering to turn facedown. Turn 1 of your normal wounds faceup or suffer 1 critical wound if you have no normal wounds.

conservative.requirements: 4 favour per severity, engaged with target, must perform a prepare manoeuvre. May only attempt this blessing once per critical wound. Special: The difficulty of this action is equal to the severity of the critical wound.
conservative.name: Cure Critical Wound

success.description: Turn 1 of the target’s critical wounds facedown.
Turn 2 of the target’s critical wounds facedown.
Turn 3 of the target’s critical wounds facedown.

bane.description: You suffer 1 wound before this blessing resolves.

chaosStar.description: Move 1 of the target’s critical wounds to another location.

reckless.requirements: 8 favour, engaged with target, must perform a manoeuvre. Special: The difficulty of this action is equal to the highest severity amongst critical wounds the target is suffering from.
reckless.name: Cure Critical Wound
